section-108-1.IF: — (a) the discrimination arises out of and is closely connected to a relationship which used to exist between them, and (b) conduct of a description constituting the discrimination would, if it occurred during the relationship, contravene this Act

section-108-2.IF: — (a) the harassment arises out of and is closely connected to a relationship which used to exist between them, and (b) conduct of a description constituting the harassment would, if it occurred during the relationship, contravene this Act

section-108-4.IF: B is placed at a substantial disadvantage as mentioned in section 20

section-108-5.FOR: sections 20, 21 and 22 and the applicable Schedules
section-108-5.TO: be construed as if the relationship had not ended

section-109-1.FOR: Anything done by a person (A) in the course of A's employment
section-109-1.TO: be treated as also done by the employer

section-109-2.FOR: Anything done by an agent for a principal, with the authority of the principal
section-109-2.TO: be treated as also done by the principal

section-109-4.TO: show that B took all reasonable steps to prevent A— (a) from doing that thing, or (b) from doing anything of that description
section-109-4.IN: proceedings against A's employer (B) in respect of anything alleged to have been done by A in the course of A's employment

section-110-1.TO: — (a) be an employee or agent, (b) do something which, by virtue of section 109(1) or (2), is treated as having been done by A's employer or principal (as the case may be), and (c) the doing of that thing by A amounts to a contravention of this Act by the employer or principal (as the case may be)

section-110-3.TO: — (a) rely on a statement by the employer or principal that doing that thing is not a contravention of this Act, and (b) it is reasonable for A to do so

section-110-4.TO: knowingly or recklessly make a statement mentioned in subsection (3)(a) which is false or misleading in a material respect

section-110-5A.TO: — (a) not conduct a relevant marriage, (b) is not present at, does not carry out, or does not otherwise participate in, a relevant marriage, or (c) not consent to a relevant marriage being conducted

section-110-5BA.TO: — (a) not allow religious premises to be used as the place at which two people register as civil partners of each other under Part 2 of the Civil Partnership Act 2004 (“the 2004 Act”), or (b) not provide, arrange, facilitate or participate in, or is not present at— (i) an occasion during which two people register as civil partners of each other on religious premises under Part 2 of the 2004 Act, or (ii) a ceremony or event in England or Wales to mark the formation of a civil partnership, for the reason that the person does not wish to do things of that sort in relation to civil partnerships generally, or those between two people of the same sex, or those between two people of the opposite sex

section-110-5C.TO: refuse to solemnise a relevant Scottish marriage for the reason that the marriage is the marriage of two persons of the same sex

section-110-5CA.TO: refuse to solemnise a relevant Scottish marriage for the reason that the marriage is the marriage of two persons of the opposite sex who are in a civil partnership with each other

section-110-5D.TO: refuse to register a relevant Scottish civil partnership for the reason that A does not wish to register civil partnerships generally, or those between two persons of the same sex, or those between two persons of the opposite sex

section-110-5G.TO: refuse to solemnise a relevant Scottish forces marriage for the reason that the marriage is the marriage of two persons of the same sex

section-111-1.TO: instruct another (B) to do in relation to a third person (C) anything which contravenes Part 3, 4, 5, 6 or 7 or section 108(1) or (2) or 112(1) (a basic contravention)

section-111-2.TO: cause another (B) to do anything which is a basic contravention

section-111-3.TO: induce another (B) to do anything which is a basic contravention

section-111-5.TO: bring proceedings for a contravention of this section
section-111-5.IF: B is subjected to a detriment as a result of A's conduct

section-111-5.TO: bring proceedings for a contravention of this section
section-111-5.IF: C is subjected to a detriment as a result of A's conduct

section-111-5.TO: bring proceedings for a contravention of this section

section-112-1.TO: knowingly help another (B) to do anything which contravenes Part 3, 4, 5, 6 or 7 or section 108(1) or (2) or 111 (a basic contravention)

section-112-2.TO: — (a) rely on a statement by B that the act for which the help is given does not contravene this Act, and (b)it is reasonable for A to do so

section-112-3.TO: knowingly or recklessly make a statement mentioned in subsection (2)(a) which is false or misleading in a material respect
